question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Indigenous
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word 'indigenous' means originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.(स्वदेशी)

 
 
• Example- Koalas are indigenous to Australia.
 
 
 
• "Aboriginal" means relating to the indigenous peoples of Australia or their languages.(आदिवासी)
 
 
• Example- The aboriginal inhabitants used the stars for navigation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of "Indigenous" is "Aboriginal".

Therefore, the correct answer is Aboriginal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences.

 
• Literary(साहित्यिक): Concerning the writing, study, or content of literature, especially of the kind valued for quality of form.

 
 
• Example- She's the literary editor of the 'Sunday Review'.
 
 
 
• Tangible(ठोस): A thing that is perceptible by touch.
 
 
• Example- The government is trying to protect tangible assets of the people.
 
 
 
• Artificial(कृत्रिम ): Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.
 
 
• Example- The dress was made of artificial silk.
